metadata.title: The sphere is the only closed surface satisfying the fixed-width Archimedean property
metadata.abstract: Among Archimedes' many celebrated discoveries is a striking fact: the region of the unit sphere between two parallel planes, both meeting the sphere and separated by a distance $h$, has area $2\pi h$. We prove that, among connected smooth closed embedded surfaces in $\mathbb R^3$, this property characterizes the unit sphere for a single fixed width.

analysis.progressType: 固定宽度 Archimedes 性质刻画球面
analysis.workSummary: 证明连通光滑闭嵌入曲面只要对一个固定宽度满足两平行截面之间面积为 2πh 的球面性质，就必须是单位球面。
analysis.breakthrough: 从单一宽度条件推出球面的全局刻画。
analysis.limitations: 曲面须连通、光滑、闭且嵌入；固定宽度的可适用截面条件应保留。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 6 Astra 辅助证明策略；第 4 节论证在 AI 辅助前已由作者完成。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 6 Astra 辅助证明策略；第 4 节论证在 AI 辅助前已由作者完成。
